verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's CLI documents creating releases (`glitchtip-cli releases new`) and recording deployments for a release, so release tracking exists. It also aims for Sentry API compatibility. Nothing in the evidence shows commit association, suspect-commit attribution, or issues displaying the release they first appeared in. Missing for 10: commit association with releases, suspect-commit detection, first-seen-release display on issues, independent or hands-on corroboration.
